parsed.rationale: I don't think this ECG is normal: the R-R intervals vary with no pattern (about 300–790 ms on the lead II strip), there are no clear P waves, and the baseline shows fine fibrillatory waves; the QRS complexes are narrow, there is no ST elevation meeting STEMI criteria, and the tall precordial voltages could point to LVH, but atrial fibrillation is the main finding.
